## Purpose
Shows the tier the orchestrator decided (foundation, domain or use case) in place of a manual picker. The identity layer classifies each new agent from the request.

## Responsibilities
- `AutoTierChip({tier})`. `TierSelector` reads `ontologyApi.tiers` for the labels.
